about: What the rater-layer converter (mappingLayers ML2-a, DESIGN-ML2a-raterLayer-102526.md) may write, as DATA. standardVersionByStandardKey: the version of every standard the raters answered, keyed by the forged stableId's own CURIE prefix and measured from GOLD_EVAL_261025_wave3's decision pairKeys (2026-10-25); an unlisted prefix is refused by name. The hub: one, CEDS, whose card URIs must begin with hubCardUriPrefix. predicateIdByAnswerRole: D-RATERPRED (Best -> edc:bestMatch, Same -> edc:alsoAcceptable); the noMatch pair is NOT here, it is imported from sssomExporter so the two cannot drift (ML1 doubt 2). raterUserNamePattern: a rater account the converter writes; its one capture group is the rater number NN (layer rater-NN, display 'rater NN, survey X').
predicateMeaningComment: Rater layer: edc:bestMatch means the rater chose this card as Best for the element, and edc:alsoAcceptable that the rater ticked it as Same (also acceptable); raters were never asked a SKOS relation (D-RATERPRED). skos:mappingRelation to sssom:NoTermFound means the rater answered No match in CEDS. Unsure answers carry no row.
